reader_summary.headline: This is my second conversation with Josh Kushner, founder and managing partner of Thrive Capital.
reader_summary.overview: This is my second conversation with Josh Kushner, founder and managing partner of Thrive Capital. I recorded this conversation in October after publishing the Colossus cover story about him and Thrive. Given the overwhelming response, we created some breathing room before releasing it.

key_points.text: The firm now manages approximately $50 billion with a very small investment team.
What makes Thrive different is how concentrated they are and how involved they get with their portfolio companies.
We cover the iconic investments that defined Thrive: Instagram, Stripe, GitHub, and spend a lot of time on OpenAI.
